title: 菊花賞の後に・アドバンス

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide loses at the Kikuka Sho, but she looks proud and satisfied to have put everything on the line to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, Narita Taishin and Winning Ticket stop by to exchange compliments and encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next race is the spring Tenno Sho. There, we'll have our rematch with Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide vows to win it with a smile that is much, much brighter than it has been recently.
